subject: Vendor security kickoff: HealthNest — questionnaire preference & SOC 2 status
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@healthnest.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-02-22T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: Vendor security kickoff: HealthNest — questionnaire preference & SOC 2 status

Hi Elena — great to meet earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery call: 

- Redwood wants to make the SIG/CAF/CAIQ or custom questionnaire process as low-friction as possible for your team.
- You mentioned HealthNest is evaluating hosted inference for patient-facing features; HIPAA scope may apply for PHI processing.
- You indicated a SOC 2 Type II audit is in-flight with a targeted completion in Q2; we should confirm controls that will be in scope.

Next steps I propose:
1) Confirm whether HealthNest prefers CAIQ (standard) or a custom questionnaire (we can prefill either).
2) Share any immediate evidence you have (network diagram, SOC 2 interim report, data flow descriptions).
3) Confirm HealthNest security point-of-contact for evidence delivery and timelines.
4) Redwood will prepare a short prefill to cut down your effort and send a list of clarifying questions by EOD.

Can you confirm preferred questionnaire format and the security contact? I’ve attached a simple intake checklist to speed things up.

Thanks —
Rishi
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.ai
Attachments: intake_checklist.pdf (stub)
From: Elena Morales <elena@healthnest.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Kim <alex.kim@healthnest.com>
Date: 2026-02-23T09:37:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor security kickoff: HealthNest — questionnaire preference & SOC 2 status

Hi Rishi — thanks for the clear recap. Confirming a few items:

- Preference: CAIQ is fine as a starting point; if you can prefill fields we’ll review and mark exceptions.
- SOC 2: We are midway through a Type II run (controls in place, collecting evidence). Auditor expects completion mid-May but we can share interim artifacts (control matrix, scope).
- HIPAA: We believe the initial pilot will include PHI, so HIPAA controls will be in scope.

Security POC: Alex Kim (cc’d) will own evidence coordination. He can receive encrypted uploads or Drive links.

We’ll attach a current network diagram and a high-level SOC 2 timeline — sending those to you now. A few clarifying questions from my side:
1) Will Redwood need a BAA if PHI is processed?
2) Do you have a short list of the specific artifact types the auditor typically requests (e.g., config screenshots vs. design docs)?
3) Are there specific cloud regions you recommend for US-sensitive workloads?

— Elena
Head of Security Programs, HealthNest
elena@healthnest.com
Attachments: HN_network_diagram_v1.pdf, SOC2_timeline_draft.docx
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <elena@healthnest.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>, Alex Kim <alex.kim@healthnest.com>
Date: 2026-02-24T11:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor security kickoff: HealthNest — questionnaire preference & SOC 2 status

Elena / Alex — great, thanks for the confirmation and the initial artifacts. Quick answers and a short ask list so we can scope the prefill correctly: 

- BAA: Yes — Redwood provides a BAA for customers processing PHI under our hosted and dedicated offerings. We’ll loop Legal once we have the scoping call complete.
- Artifact types: For SOC 2 prefill and evidence planning we typically request: control matrix (mapping), latest SOC 2 interim report or evidence packs, network diagram (you sent — thanks), identity provider config screenshots (Okta/Azure AD), a sample change control ticket, encryption at rest config summary, and a dataflow that highlights PHI touchpoints.
- Regions: For US PHI we recommend US-central or US-west regions (we can pin inference to region-level dedicated capacity for residency).

Please confirm the following so we can prepare the CAIQ prefill and a minimal custom appendix for HIPAA: 
A) Confirm whether HealthNest expects Redwood to store model logs that may contain PHI, or whether logs will be disabled/obfuscated.
B) Is the pilot limited to a single AWS account (preferred) or multiple accounts across environments?
C) Desired SOC 2 artifacts to start with (pick up to 4): control matrix, interim auditor notes, idp screenshots, encryption config summary.

If you confirm A–C by EOD Thursday we’ll produce a CAIQ prefill and an evidence checklist for Alex to drop artifacts into.

Thanks —
Rishi
Director, Solutions — Redwood Inference
From: Alex Kim <alex.kim@healthnest.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-02-25T09:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Vendor security kickoff: HealthNest — questionnaire preference & SOC 2 status

Thanks team — quick responses from HealthNest security: 

A) Logs: Pilot will avoid storing PHI in logs. We will provide sanitized samples for verification; full logging will be disabled or obfuscated.
B) AWS accounts: Pilot will run from a single AWS account (we’ll provide account id during intake).
C) Artifacts to start: control matrix, interim auditor notes, idp screenshots, and encryption-at-rest summary.

I’ll create a shared, access-controlled Drive folder and drop the artifacts there today. Please send the CAIQ prefill and a HIPAA appendix to that folder (link to follow).

Alex Kim
Security Engineering Manager — HealthNest
alex.kim@healthnest.com
